# places.mjs

[Source](https://github.com/uol-library/spacefinder/blob/develop/assets/js/modules/places.mjs)

The list of places

Loads the current dataset's data.json and module, renders the list view,
and handles selecting, searching, filtering and sorting places. The dataset
module turns the data into place objects (onloadPlaceData) and supplies
the HTML for each place (getPlaceHTML and getAdditionalInfo).

**Exports:** `activateSort`, `sortPlaces`

<a name="applyFilters"></a>

## applyFilters()
Applies filters to the list of places

**Kind**: global function  
<a name="updateListFilterMessage"></a>

## updateListFilterMessage()
Updates the message above the list of places to show what 
search terms and filters are active

**Kind**: global function  
<a name="selectPlace"></a>

## selectPlace(placeid, source)
Selects a place in the list

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| placeid | <code>integer</code> | ID of place to be selected |
| source | <code>string</code> | Source of selection (map, list, load) |

<a name="deselectPlaces"></a>

## deselectPlaces(placeid)
Deselects a place in the list, an optionally scrolls the list to the top
and recentres the map.

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| placeid | <code>integer</code> \| <code>Object</code> \| <code>boolean</code> | ID of place which has been deselected (or an object with an id property, from the map), or false to deselect any place |

<a name="activateSort"></a>

## activateSort(activate, sorttype)
Activates sorting the list of places in the UI.

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| activate | <code>boolean</code> | whether to activate of deactivate sorting. |
| sorttype | <code>string</code> | either alpha or distance. |

<a name="sortPlacesListener"></a>

## sortPlacesListener(event)
Function used as an event listener on the sorting buttons

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| event | <code>Event</code> | event from button click |

<a name="sortPlaces"></a>

## sortPlaces(sortby, dir)
Function to sort places. Sorts using data attributes on 
place containers (sortalpha, sortdistance)

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sortby | <code>string</code> | property we are using to sort the list (needs to be part of a data attribute) |
| dir | <code>boolean</code> | sort direction (true = asc, false = desc) |

<a name="comparer"></a>

## comparer(asc, attr) ⇒
Comparer function

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: sorting function for Array.sort()  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| asc | <code>boolean</code> | ascending or decending sort mode |
| attr | <code>string</code> | attribute name for sort key |

<a name="sortPlacesByTitle"></a>

## sortPlacesByTitle(places)
Adds a sort key to each place (from its title) and sorts the places alphabetically

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type |
| --- | --- |
| places | <code>Array</code> | 

<a name="loadPlaces"></a>

## loadPlaces()
Loads all place data from a single JSON file

**Kind**: global function  
<a name="renderList"></a>

## renderList()
Renders list view for places

**Kind**: global function  
<a name="renderAdditionalInfo"></a>

## renderAdditionalInfo()
Renders additional information for all places (hidden until a place is selected)

**Kind**: global function  
<a name="showAdditionalInfo"></a>

## showAdditionalInfo(placeid)
Shows additional information about a place.
Additional information is rendered with the list (hidden) - when a place
is selected, its additional information is shown and all others are hidden.

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| placeid | <code>integer</code> | ID of place, or false to hide all |
